pagure_url.description: Public-facing URL of the Pagure instance (e.g., https://pagure.example.com/). Required for email links and redirects.

host.description: IP address to bind the internal Flask server to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

port.description: Port number for the internal Flask server.

git_folder.description: Absolute path to the directory where Git repositories are stored.

docs_folder.description: Absolute path to directory for rendered documentation (e.g., HTML versions of READMEs).

attachments_folder.description: Absolute path to directory for user-uploaded attachments (issues, PRs, etc.).

avatars_folder.description: Absolute path to directory for user and project avatar images.

static_folder.description: Directory containing static assets (CSS, JS, images) served by Pagure.

static_url_path.description: URL prefix under which static assets are served (must begin and end with '/').

template_folder.description: Directory with Jinja2 templates for the web UI.

db_uri.description: Database connection URI (e.g., sqlite, PostgreSQL, MySQL). Default is SQLite for standalone instances.

git_http.description: Enable Git operations over HTTP (GET/POST). Usually disabled; use SSH or Git over HTTPS instead.

git_ssh.description: Enable Git operations over SSH (push/pull via ssh:// or git://).

git_anonymous_clone.description: Allow anonymous Git clone (read-only) for public projects.

use_ssl.description: When behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS, set to true to force secure scheme.

debug.description: Enable detailed error pages and debug logging. Disable in production.

items_per_page.description: Default number of items (issues, PRs, commits) per page in paginated views.

request_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for outgoing HTTP requests (e.g., webhooks, email SMTP).

git_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for Git operations (clone, fetch, push).

email_require_confirmation.description: Require new users to confirm email address before full access.

ssh_keydir.description: Directory where Pagure writes SSH public keys for Git access control.

hooks_dir.description: Directory containing Git hooks used by Pagure for integration (e.g., webhooks).

email_templates_dir.description: Directory with Jinja2 templates for email notifications.
